findings.detail: __init__ 'Struct___init___impl' is re-callable on a live object and its second call destroys and replaces self->s_codes. unpackiter_iternext (line 2274) still reads that state through a stored owner pointer (self->so->s_size), so every invariant it validated at construction time — buffer bounds, element size, cached counts — is void after the re-init. Fix: reject the second call, or give the view its own snapshot of s_size
Py_DECREF(del) at line 106 may release the last reference; 'del' is then dereferenced here. Hoist the read above the release, or hold a reference across it
Py_DECREF(exporter) at line 33 may release the last reference; 'exporter' is then dereferenced here. Hoist the read above the release, or hold a reference across it

'it' is borrowed from bo->it at line 196; iternext() [= Py_TYPE(...)->tp_iternext] can run arbitrary Python, and a re-entrant call reaching the bo->it clear at line 224 frees the object 'it' still points at -- which is then dereferenced or called here. Re-read bo->it after the call and bail on NULL (the pairwise_next pattern), or hold a strong reference for the duration

'it' is borrowed from lz->it at line 1701; iternext() [= Py_TYPE(...)->tp_iternext] can run arbitrary Python, and a re-entrant call reaching the lz->it clear at line 1732 frees the object 'it' still points at -- which is then dereferenced or called here. Re-read lz->it after the call and bail on NULL (the pairwise_next pattern), or hold a strong reference for the duration

'result' is borrowed from lz->long_cnt here; PyNumber_Add can run arbitrary Python before lz->long_cnt is overwritten at line 3639, and 'result' then escapes at line 3641. A re-entrant call performs the same transfer, so the single reference is handed to two owners. Take a reference on lz->long_cnt before the call, or re-read the slot after it
